03 · Rules

How each bird decides

04 · Prototype

Six versions

v02D boids

1,600 birds, fixed-radius neighbours. Shapes creased like paper.
replaced

v13D field + lobes

Velocity field and soft ellipsoids. Sliced into layers, like a spiral potato.
replaced

v2StarDisplay

7 nearest neighbours, banking shade, roost. Smooth gradients.
kept

v3Blind angle, banking, reaction

Rear blind cone, roll in / roll out, re-sense every 50 ms. 10,000 birds at 15 ms per frame.
kept

v4Thinner, slower

Turns start at the edge, speed −25%. 14,000 birds. Wide but fuzzy.
kept

v5Surface tension

Density field: edge pulled in, centre pushed out. Round, taut lobes.
final
